artboards.title: Today · a stop with a note
Planner · a stop selected, two drags in flight

annotations.text: Three ways to shape the day list. A is what the app screens are built on, because it is what you described. B and C are here so you can see what you are giving up. They are sketches, not proposals - say the word and I will build one out properly.

THE WAY IN

Sign in · Trips · New trip · a brand new trip, which is the first thing anyone actually sees and had no design until now · Today once it has stops.

Every phone artboard is 375 x 667: a small phone with the browser's own chrome already taken off. Not 390 x 844, which is a viewport almost nobody has.

STATES THAT WERE MISSING

Empty trip: no pins, no stops, and two ways out - find a place, or bring in a My Map. Everything else on this canvas assumed a full trip.

No connection: the app keeps working. A strip says so and counts what is waiting, a change made offline carries a clock, and something added offline is dashed until it is shared. PLAN.md calls offline a requirement and nothing had drawn it.

PLANNER · DESKTOP

Click an empty cell and search opens there, scoped to that day and hour. Click an event for Edit, Add note, Delete. The plus at each end of the grid extends the trip by a day.

Cards now carry the author avatar the phone cards have.

PLANNER · SELECTION AND DRAG

Two drags at once, which would not happen in life but shows both halves. On Sat Oct 3 an event already on the grid moves up its own day, leaving a dashed ghost. On Mon Oct 5 an item is dragged in from To be planned, its sidebar row dashed out until it lands.

PLAN ON A PHONE · NOT IN V1

The answer to your question, drawn so you can judge it. A seven-column grid cannot work at 375px, so this is one day per screen with the time running down and the gaps drawn to scale. It is Direction C from the other page, which earns its place here.

My read: Today plus the full list already covers planning on a phone, and this is the thing to build only if that turns out false. See PLAN.md section 4f.
